questions.text: Within the past 12Mo we worried whether our food would run out before we got money to buy more
Within the past 12Mo the food we bought just didn't last and we didn't have money to get more

title: Hunger Vital Sign™ (Food Insecurity Screen)
about: Two statements about the household's food in the past 12 months, from Children's HealthWatch. It has no total: often or sometimes true to either is a positive screen, at risk for food insecurity.
instructions: For each statement, check whether it was often true, sometimes true, or never true for your household.

rules_source.citation: Hager ER, Quigg AM, Black MM, et al. Pediatrics. 2010;126(1):e26-32; Children's HealthWatch, The Hunger Vital Sign.
rules_source.stated: Hager 2010 abstract: "An affirmative response to either question 1 or 2 had a sensitivity of 97% and specificity of 83%." Children's HealthWatch: a household screens positive if it answers that either or both statements is "often true" or "sometimes true" (versus "never true").

source.citation: Children's HealthWatch, The Hunger Vital Sign
source.stated: The tool asks whether each statement is "often true," "sometimes true," or "never true"; it has no total, a positive screen being either statement often or sometimes true. LOINC's answer lists add "DK or Refused" (unscored) and score the other answers 1, 1, 0.
